## Key decision: PGlite for deterministic DB tests
Spiked & confirmed: @electric-sql/pglite runs plpgsql triggers, RLS FORCE + non-superuser role + SET LOCAL
tenant isolation, transaction-scoped SET LOCAL, partial unique indexes — all in-process, no Docker. So the
"(deterministic)" DB ACs run as ordinary vitest unit tests (in the first CI job), not just integration.
SQL migrations are the authoritative DDL; Drizzle schema is the typed query layer; both verified against the
same migrated PGlite db.

## Cross-cutting invariants to re-check before PR
- Immutability = state not stored flag; obligation row is the one mutable exception (cached by trigger).
- Canonical vocabularies in every enum; no synonym survives.
- Obligations add NO new ArtifactKind (63 stays; preference_profile is the 63rd, R9).
